bestBets.overview: Eight on the agenda at Moruya on Sunday. Conditions were rated Good 4 on Friday when this preview was done but we are only going one way with 5-10mm worth of rainfall expected from early on raceday. We open with a 1425m Maiden and expect 9 could head up front in this one. LAUREATA draws to settle nice and handy today should they choose. Leading rider Pierre Boudvillain is back in business this weekend and takes the ride. FILL UP has had two quiet trials, not to bad in the latest. We can watch betting with him.

The 6YO mare's career consists of two starts and two long breaks but she's a natural sprinter that could go again. LET'S GO BRANDON is an interesting runner resuming in new hands.
